title: Can the iOS 16.5 graphics stack present a first frame without a full GPU driver? Source and static review of the extracted backboardd/SpringBoard/QuartzCore/IOMobileFramebuffer path and the donor Mesa/OSMesa route (HackiOS GL=1) against the project's MiniIOMobileFramebuffer/MiniIOSurface; no software rendering is promised.
acceptance: The note traces, with file or image-name evidence, what backboardd needs from the kernel to put a frame on a panel (IOMobileFramebuffer calls, IOSurface, a renderer) and which of these the project kernel's stand-ins implement or lack.
It states what the donor path (OpenGL ES through Mesa/OSMesa, boot-arg gpu) proves on its own hardware and what it leaves open here; claims stay claims.
It names the cheapest observation on the S24 that would decide whether a frame can be presented without a GPU, and what can be prepared on the host.
